extras: Desktop-only plugin; generated PDFs are cached in the operating system temp directory.
problem: Users need a way to view proprietary office document formats (like DOCX or XLSX) within Obsidian without relying on external applications or creating copies of the files.
summary: Local Office Preview provides a read-only, local preview of common office documents (PPT, DOC, XLS) and text files without creating duplicate preview files in the vault.
